mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sec_kill_message_outbox (message_id, request_id, member_id, member_username, member_receive_address_id, flash_promotion_product_relation_id, product_id, quantity, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, create_time, update_time, last_error) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{requestId}, #{memberId}, #{memberUsername}, #{memberReceiveAddressId}, #{flashPromotionProductRelationId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{nextRetryTime}, NOW(), NOW(), #{lastError})
mapper.update: UPDATE sec_kill_message_outbox SET status = 'RESERVED', update_time = NOW(), last_error = NULL WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND status IN ('INIT', 'FAILED', 'PROCESSING')
UPDATE sec_kill_message_outbox SET status = 'PROCESSING', update_time = NOW() WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND status IN ('INIT', 'RESERVED', 'FAILED', 'PROCESSING')
UPDATE sec_kill_message_outbox SET status = 'SENT', update_time = NOW(), last_error = NULL WHERE message_id = #{messageId}
UPDATE sec_kill_message_outbox SET status = 'FAILED', retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, update_time = NOW(), last_error = #{lastError} WHERE message_id = #{messageId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, message_id, request_id, member_id, member_username, member_receive_address_id, flash_promotion_product_relation_id, product_id, quantity, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, create_time, update_time, last_error FROM sec_kill_message_outbox WHERE ( status IN ('INIT', 'RESERVED', 'FAILED') AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= NOW()) ) OR ( status = 'PROCESSING' AND update_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{processingTimeoutSeconds} SECOND) ) ORDER BY create_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
